integrity: Exact combinatorial proof and recurrence inequalities are supplied; the independent small-size enumerator is corroborative and not an infinite proof. All prior literature comparisons are best-knowledge scientific comparisons, not independent priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Uniform measure on all matching incidence vertices of the complete graph, not volume-uniform, fixed-cardinality, weighted, fractional, or general-graph measure. Domain n>=4; known association-scheme and monomer-dimer methods may yield equivalent prior formulations. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Exact vertex-inertia spectrum and square-root anisotropy of complete-graph matching polytopes
